headline: Lockheed Martin Lands Pentagon Deal for 850 F-35 Jets and Lifts Forecast
summary: Lockheed Martin secured a major Pentagon contract for 850 F-35 fighter jets and raised its annual financial forecast.
why: Lockheed Martin is one of the world's largest defense contractors, relying heavily on long-term procurement programs with the US Department of Defense.

impacts.name: Lockheed Martin
impacts.why: A massive multi-jet defense contract and upgraded annual guidance directly improve the company's revenue outlook.

why_moved: The large-scale procurement order guarantees long-term multi-year revenue streams, prompting management to raise forward guidance.
